0022600008.text: The Celtics, who are 0-1 and have dropped their only game so far, sit fifth in the Atlantic, 0.5 games back, and 15th in the East. Devin Carter is out with an illness, and he averaged 8.9 points and 18.4 minutes per game last season. The Knicks have not played a 2026-27 game yet, and the teams have not met this season, but in 2025-26 the Celtics lost the series 1-3, including a 112-106 loss in New York on April 9.
